postings.title: Senior Account Manager
postings.description:
SENIOR ACCOUNT MANAGER

New York, NY (hybrid, Pacific time hours) | Full-time



We're hiring a Senior Account Manager to lead a pod of beauty and wellness brands on TikTok Shop and the team that runs them. You'll own the pod's GMV targets and client retention, set each brand's quarterly plan, and be the person clients and your team turn to when a decision needs to be made. Your focus is direction, unlocking client resources, and developing your people, not running every account yourself. You'll have a real hand in growing your team and shaping your pod into the best version of itself.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

You'll lead a pod of beauty and wellness brands and directly manage the Account Managers, Creator Managers, and Ops Specialists who run them day to day. A typical week includes reviewing performance across every account in Seller Center and Cruva, updating forecasts, and checking that each brand's daily work lines up with its growth goals. You'll meet with your team to set priorities and a plan to hit them, join weekly client calls, and step in on escalations. You'll work most closely with your pod and with brand decision makers, where you'll make the case for recommendations like more ads budget or higher sampling volume. Staying close to internal and client conversations every day is what lets you make well-informed calls.



- Own pod GMV forecasts and targets, using Seller Center and Cruva data to set realistic projections and expectations with clients

- Build each brand's quarterly plan around its core business goal, and turn it into weekly priorities your pod executes

- Manage and develop your pod's Account Managers, Creator Managers, and Ops Specialists through regular check-ins, feedback, and coaching

- Track performance across every account so you can answer escalations and big-picture client questions on the spot

- Push for the resources each brand needs to hit its goals, such as GMV Max budget, sampling volume, paid creator campaigns, and launch support

- Own client relationships and retention across your pod, and serve as the escalation point for clients and your team

- Set direction when priorities conflict or plans change, and onboard new brands and team members into the pod

- Lead QBRs and quarterly planning with brand decision makers, presenting results, forecasts, and recommendations




WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- 1+ year of hands-on TikTok Shop experience, ideally at a seller-side agency. Brand-side experience is also considered.

- 3+ years of experience in marketing, e-commerce, or a related field

- 2+ years of managing people, including giving feedback and developing direct reports

- Comfort reading performance data, spotting trends, and building realistic forecasts from it

- Working knowledge of the TikTok Shop creator and affiliate ecosystem

- Experience presenting to senior client stakeholders and getting buy-in on recommendations, budgets, or strategy changes




WHAT WE'D LIKE YOU TO HAVE

- TikTok ads experience, especially GMV Max. Our pods run GMV Max on every account, so this helps you guide your Account Managers from day one.

- Comfort using AI tools in your workflow. We use Claude across planning, analysis, and client prep, and we'll get you up to speed if you're newer to it.

- Beauty or wellness brand experience. Most of our brands are in these categories, so it helps you speak the client's language faster.




WHAT WE REQUIRE

- You'll work from our Midtown Manhattan office four days a week, Monday through Thursday.

- Regular overlap with Pacific time hours. Your pod and many of its clients are on the West Coast, so plan for your day to run later than a typical East Coast schedule, with flexibility beyond that when clients need it.




WHAT WE'RE COUNTING ON FROM YOU

In your first 90 days, you'll know every brand in your pod well enough to explain its goals, performance, risks, and priorities without prep. You'll have met one on one with each person on your team and set clear development goals with them, and you'll have shared a plan with the Lead Senior Account Manager you report to for closing your pod's biggest gaps in resourcing, process, or skills. You'll have built a GMV forecast and a QBR for each brand, led each QBR call with support from the brand's Account Manager, and become the first point of escalation for your pod's clients and team.



After a year, we'll measure your success by whether your pod kept its clients and hit, or closely tracked, its GMV targets, with forecasts that held up against actual results. By then you'll be building and presenting QBRs and quarterly plans on your own, making recommendations directly to brand decision makers, and you'll have secured at least one major resource ask, like more ads budget or sampling volume. We'll also look at whether you've developed at least one person on your team to promoted or promotion-ready, shared learnings that other pods adopted, and brought new brands and hires into the pod so they're running on their own within their first 90 days.



If you've led a team on TikTok Shop and you're ready to own a pod's results, we'd love to hear from you.






ABOUT SPOTLIGHT MEDIA

Spotlight Media is a leading, award-winning TikTok Shop agency and an official TikTok Shop Partner. We help brands and creators scale on TikTok Shop through end-to-end management, paid creator campaigns, and a constant growth strategy mindset. We’re profitable, fully bootstrapped, and growing extremely fast.



Spotlight is a place for high-agency people who want ownership and autonomy and can operate with speed. Much of what we need hasn’t been built yet, and the people who join now will shape it. Our mission is for the time you spend at Spotlight to be the most rewarding time in your career.




BENEFITS

- Medical, dental, and vision coverage

- 401(k)

- Take-as-needed PTO after 90 days

- Office supply stipend

- Company bonuses

- Employee referral bonuses

- Brand referral bonuses



---




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

postings.title: Account Manager
postings.description:
ACCOUNT MANAGER

New York, NY (hybrid) | Full-time



We're hiring an Account Manager to take over a portfolio of brands on TikTok Shop and be the day-to-day lead for each one. You'll own each account's plan and results, with a Senior Account Manager beside you on strategy and escalations. The pod structure is new, so you'll help shape how it runs, and there's a clear path to Senior Account Manager as you grow.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

You'll be the main point of contact for each brand in your portfolio and the owner of each account's plan and results. A typical week includes leading client calls, reviewing performance in Seller Center and Cruva, adjusting GMV Max ads against ROI targets, and turning each brand's goals into clear assignments for your pod. You'll work most closely with your pod's Creator Manager and Ops Specialist, who handle creators, sampling, and shop operations, and you'll partner with brand teams and their TikTok reps on launches, promotions, and product plans.



- Own GMV against plan for each brand in your portfolio

- Lead weekly client calls, including strategy and product planning conversations

- Assign and track work across your Creator Manager and Ops Specialist based on each account's goals

- Manage GMV Max ads day to day, including budgets and ROI targets, with input from Ops

- Build hero SKU, offer, promotion, and campaign plans with each brand, including launches and seasonal events

- Dig into what's driving performance up or down, and share what you learn across the pod

- Keep every account organized with clear owners, next steps, and fast client response times

- Manage relationships with each brand's TikTok Shop rep




WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- 2+ years of experience in marketing, e-commerce, or agency roles

- Hands-on TikTok Shop experience and a working understanding of how the platform and its seller services work. Six months or more is ideal.

- Experience leading client calls and presenting strategy or product plans directly to brands

- Experience managing multiple accounts or projects at once while keeping owners, timelines, and next steps clear

- Experience directing or assigning work to teammates based on goals and priorities

- A track record of digging into why results changed and turning that into a clear recommendation




WHAT WE'D LIKE YOU TO HAVE

- GMV Max experience. You'll run GMV Max ads on your accounts, so it shortens your ramp, but we'll train strong candidates who haven't used it yet.

- Brand-side TikTok Shop or Meta experience, or time at TikTok or another TikTok Shop agency. It helps you understand what brands need from us and how the platform works from the inside.

- Interest in beauty. Most of our brands are in beauty and wellness, so it helps you speak their language from day one.






WHAT WE REQUIRE

- You'll work from our Midtown Manhattan office four days a week, Monday through Thursday.

- Flexibility to adjust your day when clients need it. We're a client-first team, so some days run outside a standard schedule.






WHAT WE'RE COUNTING ON FROM YOU

In your first 90 days, we'll be looking for you to take full ownership of your portfolio. That means you're leading every weekly client call, sending agendas ahead and recaps within 24 hours, and keeping a current plan for each brand that you review weekly with your Senior Account Manager. You'll have taken over GMV Max ads on your accounts with budgets and ROI targets in place, set a regular rhythm with each brand's contacts and TikTok Shop rep, and spotted at least one account risk early enough to fix it before it showed up in results.



By the end of your first year, you'll have built a quarterly strategy plan for each brand, led a quarterly business review on your own, and taken a product launch from plan through results. You'll be the pod's go-to person on GMV Max, your learnings will be shaping how other brands and pods work, and you'll have mentored a newer teammate along the way.



If you know TikTok Shop and want to own real accounts with real support behind you, we'd love to hear from you.

We help brands and creators scale on TikTok Shop through end-to-end management, paid creator campaigns, and a constant growth strategy mindset. We’re profitable, fully bootstrapped, and growing extremely fast.



Spotlight is a place for high-agency people who want ownership and autonomy and can operate with speed. Much of what we need hasn’t been built yet, and the people who join now will shape it. Our mission is for the time you spend at Spotlight to be the most rewarding time in your career.

postings.title: Creator Manager
postings.description:
CREATOR MANAGER

New York, NY (hybrid, Pacific time hours) | Full-time



More brands are coming to us for paid creator programs alongside our full-service TikTok Shop accounts, and we're adding a Creator Manager so every pod has the creator coverage it needs. You'll build the creator strategy for a portfolio of beauty and personal care brands and run both sides of it: paid creator programs from first outreach to renewal, and the affiliate program day to day. You'll join a pod led by a West Coast-based Senior Account Manager and have the availability to work Pacific hours alongside the pod's Account Manager and Ops Specialist. This is an experienced role with no direct reports, and you'll join while our processes and creator platform are still taking shape.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Your week runs on two tracks. On one, two to four paid creator rounds sit at different stages. In a single week you might build an outreach list for one, negotiate rates on another, review drafts on a third, and wrap up the last with payment, reporting, and renewal, all in our creator portal. On the other track, you run the affiliate side for 4 to 6 brands: outreach going out, sampling decisions, the creator community, fresh briefs, and check-ins with each brand's top creators. Every brand has a weekly client call where you present the creator numbers and what you'd do next, and you refresh each brand's creator plan monthly. You'll work most with creators, then with your pod's Account Manager and Ops Specialist, and with clients on those calls.



- Build the creator strategy for each of your 4 to 6 brands, turning their goals into measurable targets and timelines across paid programs, affiliates, and the creator community

- Run paid creator programs end to end: outreach, rate negotiation, agreements, content review, payment, client reporting, and renewal

- Own affiliate strategy and the initiatives around launches and campaigns, including target creator lists, collabs, sampling, pre-seeding, launch-day messages, webinars, lives, and competitions

- Write creator outreach and briefs, and answer creator questions across DMs, text, email, and the creator community

- Set and track KPIs across paid and affiliate programs, own weekly and monthly reporting for your pod and your clients, and feed what you learn back into the strategy

- Grow each brand's creator community: bring affiliates in, keep a steady communication rhythm, track your top creators, and run initiatives that lift affiliate performance

- Spot process gaps, work across teams to fix them, and help build our Creator Manager playbooks




WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- 2 to 3+ years in creator or influencer marketing, partnerships, account management, customer success, or strategy and operations

- Experience turning goals into plans and managing several at once, each with its own deadlines and budget

- A record of building long-term partner relationships

- Strong persuasive writing for outreach and creative briefs

- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn creator metrics into business outcomes and clear recommendations

- Professional, client-facing communication, written and spoken




WHAT WE'D LIKE YOU TO HAVE

- Experience with affiliate creators, or a real interest in the creator economy. We'll teach you the TikTok Shop basics. What matters most is understanding how creators and brands work together.

- Startup experience. Our processes and creator platform are still being built, so comfort with ambiguity and a willingness to help build the structure both matter.

- Comfort with AI tools. We use them across creator workflows, analytics, and reporting.




WHAT WE REQUIRE

- You'll work from our Midtown Manhattan office four days a week, Monday through Thursday.

- Regular overlap with Pacific time hours. Your pod and many of its clients are on the West Coast, so plan for your day to run later than a typical East Coast schedule, with flexibility beyond that when clients need it.




WHAT WE'RE COUNTING ON FROM YOU

In your first 30 days, you'll be running the creator work on your first brand on your own and will have delivered your first paid creator campaign from start to finish. By 90 days, you'll own the creator side of every brand you're assigned, with clients bringing creator questions straight to you. You'll have written and presented a creator plan for each brand, delivered two to three paid campaigns on your own, and run a creator initiative like a webinar, competition, or pre-seeding push. You'll also have set affiliate GMV and video targets with your pod, reported on them in every weekly client call, and flagged the two biggest process gaps you've found to the teams who can fix them.



After a year, we'll measure your success by whether affiliate GMV on your brands has grown, both in dollars and as a share of each brand's total GMV. We'll also look at whether each brand hit its video targets with more content coming from higher-tier creators, whether paid programs renewed with creators coming back for repeat rounds, and whether your creator communities stayed active with top creators sticking around. Every round, launch, and competition should land on the agreed client date, and at least one process fix you identified should be in use across the team.



If you love working with creators and want to help build how a fast-growing team does it, we'd love to hear from you.




ABOUT SPOTLIGHT MEDIA

Spotlight Media is a leading, award-winning TikTok Shop agency and an official TikTok Shop Partner. We help brands and creators scale on TikTok Shop through end-to-end management, paid creator campaigns, and a constant growth strategy mindset.
